description: License texts for distributed crates whose published package carries no license file. Read by scripts/generate-third-party-licenses.ps1 only for packages that really have none. Entries are pinned to an exact name and version: a version bump drops the entry, the generator then fails for that crate, and a maintainer re-checks upstream before extending the pin. Each text is copied verbatim from the upstream repository named in 'source' (fetched 2026-10-22); 'fromPackage' reuses the license files of a sibling crate from the same upstream repository (same project, same license). Review these entries when they change.
